nom: Paula's Choice Clear Regular Strength Anti-Redness Exfoliating Solution With 2% Salicylic Acid

avis.texte: IMPORTANT: I'm 34, male, had very bad oil and acne in my late teens and early twenties. In my late twenties till today, my skin is pretty much fine (especially compared to early years). However, there was always an issue with enlarged/clogged pores, the right amount of moisture, redness, etc. The large pimples were largely a thing of the past, and while I realized that less is more, I still wondered if there were a product that would improve my complexion. I read that salicylic acid was THE thing for pores and redness, but I was like "well i tried it in face washes and exfoliators and it didn't improve things much and made my skin too sensitive". However, I read on some blog that salicylic acid in face washes is largely rubbish, because it is truly and only effective if it stays ON the skin. That blog recommended different products, some of them quite expensive, and listed as a cost effective option....Paula's Choice...this product right here. The bottle lasts a long time. For me, over six months. That makes it very cheap despite what I considered a hefty price tag up front of $25. I use it almost twice a day. And it helps a lot. It helps my skin retain a "after washing and moisturizing" look long after the cleansing has been done. It really helps the overall balance - not getting too oily, not as clogged, and without the harshness of other things I've tried in the past. The 2% BHA helps keep my pores clear and smooth without being harsh or irritating. It feels lightweight, almost like water, and sinks right into the skin without leaving any sticky residue. avis.titre: no more of this stuff, I'm done
avis.texte: I've purchased this 30 times over the years and have hated that I needed it and have always wanted to change to something else for adult acne (I'm 40 and have oily and sensitive skin). All of the 'acids' and harsh cleansers I've been steadily getting away from (including the organic/natural ones). When I use this on my face, I have more oil production and my face feels dry. I will wake up the next day with red hive like pimples on my cheeks and chin, that itch. Then over time I'll get a build up underneath the surface, like pimples that haven't surfaced yet and my skin looks congested. I hate that I've used this over the years with nothing else that could be better and healthier. But changing products takes a lot of time and money. I've finally moved away from using this on my face, I think I've found something else to replace it. And now that I have my face figured out, my body is a whole other issue...I still use this, but on my chest only. So, 3 stars for that, I guess.

avis.titre: Quick results after a decade of fighting my skin
avis.texte: If you're a girl sick of having clogged, acne-constant, oily skin and you feel like you've tried every product on the market and you feel like you're doing everything right but your skin still looks horrible... Get. This. Product. Worth every penny. Oh, and results are fast. Know that lathering your face in it will hurt your skin barrier and freak your skin out, so dont do that. But I use this morning and night right after cleansing. I use just a few drops on a cotton pad and swipe it across my acne problem areas. Clears up breakouts like nothing else and my skin is glowy for the first time in my life. I never realized how much of my skin troubles were based on a texture, not just acne, until I started using this product! Clogged pores got nothing on me now that I've got this!
